subject: Expansion: Zenith Health — Sprintwise team enablement & API key allocation
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@zenithhealth.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: rajiv.menon@zenithhealth.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion request — 3 new project teams + API key request

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Our product org (Rajiv and I) ran a quick intake and we want to move forward with rolling Redwood out to three additional project teams over the next two sprints. High level:

- Projects: CareNavigator (patient triage), ClaimsAssist (claims summarization), IntakeForms (structured extraction)
- Estimated concurrent pipelines: 8–12 warm sessions per team, burst to ~40 during peak (batchable)
- Need: separate API keys per project, role-based access for engineers, and a brief onboarding session for dev leads

Can you send an updated quote for the incremental capacity and a recommended rollout timeline? Also, we do have a procurement window coming up — if there are any term changes required (commit adjustments / term extension) please flag them early so we can coordinate with Purchasing.

Attachments: our internal project intake doc (summary).

Best,
Emily
Emily Carter
Head of Product Integrations, Zenith Health
emily.carter@zenithhealth.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@zenithhealth.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — 3 new project teams + API key request

Emily — thanks, this is great context.

Quick answers up front: yes, we can provision separate API keys per project and set RBAC scoping for each key. Given the concurrency profile, I recommend the following:

1) Short term (first 2 sprints): add a 1.5x burst capacity buffer on top of current Dedicated pool (covers the ~40 burst) + per-project key provisioning.
2) Mid term (30–60 days): move CareNavigator and ClaimsAssist to pinned model instances for lower p99 latency; IntakeForms can start on shared pool with caching enabled.
3) Ops & governance: we’ll provide a key rotation schedule, role assignments for each dev lead, and an onboarding workshop (1.5 hours) for the three teams.

I’ve looped in Dev (Dev Patel) to scope the ops changes and Marissa on billing/terms so we can indicate any delta to your current commitment. Can you confirm whether Purchasing requires a PO + SOW or prefers a single addendum to the existing order? Also, any compliance evidence (SOC2 / logging retention) you'd need upfront?

I’ll attach a preliminary quote and a proposed timeline by Monday.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
Office: +1 650-555-0123

Attachment: zenith_additional_apps_quote.pdf (summary quote — incremental monthly cost and estimated token usage)
From: dev_patel@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: capacity / provisioning notes for Zenith expansion

Aditya / Marissa — quick internal note before I send the provisioning plan to Emily:

- Capacity: current Dedicated pool for Zenith has headroom of ~20% during off-peak. For the requested burst profile we should:
  * Provision an on-call burst pack (2x N GPUs for 2 weeks) scoped to their account for initial ramp OR
  * Add a dedicated extra slot (1x A100 equivalent) with autoscale policies targeting the 90th percentile; cheaper long-term is adding the slot and using smart routing.
- Keys: we will create three project-scoped API keys and one admin key for their security team. Recommend enabling KV prefix caching for IntakeForms to reduce token spend.
- Rollout timeline: 1) key & RBAC creation (48 hrs); 2) onboarding workshop (week of 5/10); 3) staged traffic (CareNavigator -> ClaimsAssist -> IntakeForms over 2 weeks).

I’ll include deployment runbooks and a brief run of the console for their dev leads. If Marissa confirms any contractual deltas we’ll add them to the quote.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Sr. Platform Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@zenithhealth.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: rajiv.menon@zenithhealth.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — 3 new project teams + API key request

Thanks — that plan sounds sensible. A few procurement notes:

- Purchasing prefers an addendum rather than a new SOW; they want to avoid renegotiating platform-wide terms.
- They asked whether adding the extra dedicated slot would change our monthly committed spend threshold. If so, we may need a short-term credit while the slot is onboarding.
- Security: we will need a short evidence packet showing log retention settings (90 days), SOC2 report reference, and confirmation that API keys can be rotated without service interruption.

Could you add a line-item for a one-time onboarding credit (equivalent of 10% of the incremental monthly) and a timeline that shows when the dedicated slot (if chosen) will be active and billed? Also, please send the keys creation plan we discussed.

Emily
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@zenithhealth.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — 3 new project teams + API key request

Emily — appreciate the clarifications. Next steps:

- Attached: updated quote (zenith_additional_apps_quote.pdf) with two options: 
  Option A: add 1x dedicated slot + RBAC + per-project keys (recommended for p99 SLAs) — shows delta to monthly commitment and the billing effective date.
  Option B: burst-pack + shared pool + caching (lower monthly but higher per-token during sustained peaks).
- We added a one-time onboarding credit (10% of first-month incremental) as requested and included explicit billing date when the dedicated slot would go live.
- Security packet: I’ve attached the standard evidence summary and will have our security team send a signed SOC2 cover note by EOD Friday. API keys can be rotated via the Console with zero-downtime if you enable the dual-key rotation workflow; I included the short runbook in the rollout spreadsheet (proposed-rollout-timeline.xlsx).

Please confirm: Purchasing prefers an addendum — we will draft and route an addendum that references the existing Master Services Agreement and the incremental capacity line items. If you approve Option A we’ll prepare the addendum + DocuSign link and provision the dedicated slot within 5 business days of signed addendum + PO.

If that timeline works I’ll schedule the onboarding workshop for the week of 5/10 and reserve the seats for your three dev leads.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the teams live.

Best,
Aditya

Attachments: zenith_additional_apps_quote.pdf; proposed-rollout-timeline.xlsx
